description: Fix quadratic per-issue token inflation feeding the split advisory by making orchTokens a per-cycle delta and marker-aware aggregation.

userStories.title: Emit cycle-tokens orchTokens as per-cycle delta with a mode marker
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need each new cycle-tokens event to record orchTokens as the per-cycle increment (delta) with an explicit orchTokensMode marker, so that downstream aggregation stops re-summing the same cumulative orchestrator spend.
acceptanceCriteria: CycleTokensEventDetail declares an optional orchTokensMode field ('delta') that marks delta-mode events; an event with no marker is defined as legacy cumulative. [oracle: grep -q 'orchTokensMode' src/supervisor/events.ts]

recordCycleTokens emits cycle-tokens events whose orchTokens is the per-cycle delta (current cumulative orchestrator spend minus the prior same-session cumulative, floored at 0) and sets orchTokensMode:'delta'. [oracle: bun test test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts]

Across consecutive cycles with a monotonically increasing orchestrator cumulative spend, the emitted per-cycle orchTokens deltas sum to the final cumulative (no quadratic re-snapshotting). [oracle: bun test test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts]
workerTokens remains a true per-cycle slice and the emitted total equals delta-orchTokens + workerTokens. [oracle: bun test test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Write-side. Files: src/supervisor/events.ts (add orchTokensMode?: 'delta' to CycleTokensEventDetail + update its doc comment at events.ts:~350-367 which currently documents orchTokens as cumulative); src/commands/journal.ts recordCycleTokens (~481-519, cumulative computed from transcript at ~493-494). Delta = current cumulative (parseTranscriptUsage: input+cacheCreation+cacheRead) minus the prior same-session cumulative. The prior cumulative must be recovered from the existing log (e.g. sum of prior delta-mode orchTokens for the same orchestrator session/transcript, floored at 0 on a session boundary where the transcript resets) - pick the simplest correct recovery via readEventLog (already injected). Do NOT rewrite the append-only .jsonl log. Keep readOrchTranscript/readEventLog/logEvent injection for hermetic tests. Tests: test/commands/journal-record-cycle-tokens.test.ts. Gotcha: cycle-tokens events carry cycleId + issueNumber + recordedAt but no explicit orchestrator session id; if you need a session boundary signal, derive it from the transcript resolution, not from a new event field unless necessary.

userStories.title: Make per-issue token aggregation marker-aware (delta sum vs legacy collapse)
userStories.description: As the split-advisory estimator, I need aggregateTokensPerIssue to stop blindly summing cumulative orchTokens, so that a jobSize=1 single-story bucket projects realistic spend instead of tens of millions of tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: aggregateTokensPerIssue branches on orchTokensMode: delta-mode events sum orchTokens directly; legacy cumulative events (absent marker) are collapsed per orchestrator-session/issue-run (not summed) using max as the monotonic best-effort final cumulative; workerTokens continue summing per-cycle. [oracle: bun test test/stats/tokens.test.ts]
Each per-issue total is recomputed from collapsed/summed orchTokens + summed workerTokens, not by summing the stored per-cycle total field. [oracle: bun test test/stats/tokens.test.ts]

New tests cover three streams for one issue: (a) legacy cumulative-only, (b) delta-only, (c) mixed legacy+delta, each asserting the corrected per-issue total. [oracle: bun test test/stats/tokens.test.ts]
A jobSize=1 bucket built from realistic per-cycle spend no longer projects tens of millions of tokens. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan-split-advisory.test.ts]
The split-advisory heuristic is unchanged: the 1.5x threshold constant and plain-mean math remain. [oracle: grep -q 'SPLIT_ADVISORY_THRESHOLD_MULTIPLIER = 1.5' src/stats/split-advisory.ts]
All pre-existing token/journal/split-advisory tests still pass. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Read-side, the actual defect fix. File: src/stats/tokens.ts applyCycleTokensDetail (~114-134); existing.total += total and existing.orchTokens += orchTokens are the quadratic bug (tokens.ts:130-132). Parse detail['orchTokensMode'] from the raw record (already a Record<string, unknown>). Delta-mode: sum orchTokens. Legacy (absent marker, monotonic cumulative): collapse per issue-run via max (gotcha 5 of the issue: no session id on the event, so max == final session total is the best-effort fallback). Mixed stream: legacy-final (max) + subsequent deltas. Recompute IssueTokenRollup.total = orchTokens + workerTokens rather than summing the stored total. Do NOT touch src/stats/split-advisory.ts (split-advisory.ts:98-100 mean + 1.5x are correct). The consumer chain is src/supervisor/plan-split-advisory.ts:78-86 (perIssue[].total -> records -> computeSplitAdvisory). Tests: test/stats/tokens.test.ts; verify realistic bucket via test/supervisor/plan-split-advisory.test.ts.
